DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_GrassMinotaur:
The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled.
When the leaf falls on its own, <characterName id=|GrassMinotaur|/> accepts its time has come.

Sheds pieces of <itemName id=|Wood_Ancient| style=|Status_Keyword|/> off its horns when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_DarkFlameFox:
It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply 
bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.

Cries drops of <itemName id=|Lava_Ancient| style=|Status_Keyword|/> if assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_VenusFlytrap:
Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. 
However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.

Spits pieces of <itemName id=|BeastBone_Ancient| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_GrassMinotaur: When activated, changes the player's attack type to and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%. Sheds pieces of off its horns when assigned to .
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_DarkFlameFox:
While in party, 
when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Burn| style=|Effect_Burn|/>, the enemy <Status_Keyword>creates flames around itself</>, dealing continuous damage equal to <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)

Cries drops of <itemName id=|Lava_Ancient| style=|Status_Keyword|/> if assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
